scripts.test: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:mobile && pnpm run test:ait && pnpm run check:ait && pnpm run test:firebase && pnpm run test:functions && pnpm run test:functions:emulator && pnpm run test:firebase:mobile-flow && pnpm run test:firebase-config && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run check:screenshots && pnpm run check:app-privacy && pnpm run test:build-workflows && pnpm run test:platform-sdk && pnpm run check:platform-sdk
scripts.test:static: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:mobile && pnpm run test:ait && pnpm run check:ait && pnpm run test:functions && pnpm run test:firebase-config && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run check:screenshots && pnpm run check:app-privacy && pnpm run test:build-workflows && pnpm run test:platform-sdk && pnpm run check:platform-sdk
scripts.test:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --project babycare-rules-test --only firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 firebase/tests/security-rules.test.mjs"
